target_line_budget: 100k+ meaningful artifact lines, not artificial source-code bloat
hard_rules: NO FINAL NPM RUNNER RECEIPT = NO RELEASE CANDIDATE
NO CLEAN TYPECHECK/BUILD/BROWSER RECEIPT = NO WORLD-CLASS LIVE CLAIM
NO PROVIDER/PAYMENT/PDF/AI RECEIPTS = NO LIVE PAID CLAIM
NO ZERO-SKIP 100K LEDGER RECONCILIATION = NO PUBLIC TOP-1 CLAIM
NO OPERATOR SIGNOFF + PUBLIC EVIDENCE BOARD = NO PRODUCTION PROMOTION
